questions.question: Do hashtags still help small accounts get discovered on Instagram?
questions.answer_summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri reportedly called hashtags a 'myth' for reach in late 2025, and the app subsequently limited hashtag functionality.

questions.question: Does reposting your feed content to Stories help you reach more people?
questions.answer_summary: Instagram has said reposting to Stories does not boost reach, according to coverage of Mosseri's comments.

questions.question: Do Instagram DMs or shares increase how far your content spreads?
questions.answer_summary: Instagram's head reportedly said no — DMs specifically do not boost reach.

questions.question: Does posting too many Stories in a day hurt your reach?
questions.answer_summary: Engadget reported that Instagram fixed a real technical bug that had been causing multiple-Stories posting to tank reach, implying this was a genuine (if since-corrected) algorithmic penalty rather than pure myth.

questions.question: Is engagement rate now weighted more heavily than raw reach for how content performs?
questions.answer_summary: Storyboard18 reported Mosseri stating that engagement rates matter more than reach for post performance.

questions.question: What did Instagram's 2024 algorithm overhaul change for small/original creators?
questions.answer_summary: TechCrunch and Engadget reported Instagram began rewarding 'original content' and penalizing content aggregators/repost accounts specifically to surface smaller, original creators more.

questions.question: What is 'sends per reach' and why does it matter for small accounts?
questions.answer_summary: Influencer Marketing Hub published a dedicated breakdown treating this as a specific metric creators should track for reach growth.

questions.question: Are small creators affected differently than big influencers by recent algorithm changes?
questions.answer_summary: Cyprus Mail specifically covered how algorithm changes affect small creators differently than established influencers.

questions.question: Does using Instagram's own editing tools (e.g., the Edits app) affect reach?
questions.answer_summary: Social Media Today reported Mosseri saying use of the Edits app boosts reach, as part of dispelling a broader 'engagement myth.'

questions.question: Why do many users feel their likes/reach have declined over time even while posting consistently?
questions.answer_summary: The Tab published an explainer specifically addressing this common perception with a stated 'actual reason' behind falling like counts.

questions.question: Does Instagram provide official guidance for creators to interpret their own reach/performance data?
questions.answer_summary: Social Samosa reported Mosseri sharing detail on how to interpret Instagram's built-in performance insights.

questions.question: Are new repost-targeting policies part of the current reach conversation?
questions.answer_summary: PetaPixel reported new Instagram policies specifically targeting reposted content as of April 2026.
